data.body: New symptom 2026-11-10 22:16 PST (session 3d705fec): MCP claim_ticket on volcanic-prim-parakeet refused with "the code the plan was reviewed against drifted: 4 dependency file(s) changed (docs/jira-sync-setup.md, src/rebar/reconciler/mutation_payloads.py, tests/unit/reconciler/mutate/test_mutation_payloads.py, tests/unit/reconciler/test_field_contract_properties.py)". Those are exactly the files change 3345 (ed6ba4c4e9b, merged ~21:13 PST) touched. The same certificate checks `certified` at verified_at_sha ed6ba4c4e9b with the worktree CLI (`rebar review-plan --status`), and the worktree CLI claim succeeded. Consistent with the MCP server evaluating claim-gate currency against its lagging code workspace; not independently confirmed on the host (production read-only, not inspected this session).
